title: Bad restriction for a DNF formula
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunction of conjunctions of literals on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate a status of free, fixed to $+1$, or fixed to $-1$. The restriction is bad for $\varphi$ if there are two binary assignments to the free coordinates for which the restricted formula has different values.
